description: This file contains functions for removing in-place tensor operations and replacing them with out-of-place equivalents in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including handling of binary in-place ops and type casting.

methods.name: isInplaceOp
methods.description: Checks if a node is an in-place operation based on its kind.

methods.name: RemoveInplaceOps
methods.description: Removes all in-place tensor operations in a graph, replacing them with out-of-place equivalents.

methods.name: ImplicitCastForBinaryInplaceOps
methods.description: Adds cast nodes before binary in-place operations to preserve type information.
